coordinate_convention: L/R denote character anatomical left/right. Front-view screen right is character left.
global_notes: Custom ParamFS* IDs must be explicitly created in Cubism and verified in exported model.
IDs or ranges alone do not create deformations. Record actual exported ranges after rigging.
Eye/Mouth effect ownership must be resolved per motion to avoid double blink or overwrite.
No ParamEyeBallX/Y target is needed for the approved solid embroidered eyes.

parameters.name: 头部左右转向
parameters.notes: Only rig gentle keyforms. In first version limit runtime to roughly [-8,8]; parameter values are not a promise of exact physical degrees.

parameters.name: 抬头低头
parameters.notes: Initial runtime envelope [-5,6].

parameters.name: 轻微歪头
parameters.notes: Initial runtime envelope [-5,5].

parameters.name: 身体左右姿态
parameters.notes: Runtime initially within [-3,3].

parameters.name: 身体轻微侧倾
parameters.notes: Runtime initially within [-2,2]. No walking or autonomous translation.

parameters.name: 轻微呼吸
parameters.notes: Choose one owner. Do not stretch weave noticeably.

parameters.name: 左眼开合
parameters.notes: Closed state is a simple curved stitched line with zero lashes. No whites, moving pupils or glints.

parameters.name: 左眼微笑
parameters.notes: Small soft arc only; do not draw extra outer-eye strokes.

parameters.name: 右眼开合
parameters.notes: Closed state is a simple curved stitched line with zero lashes. No whites, moving pupils or glints.

parameters.name: 右眼微笑
parameters.notes: Small soft arc only; do not draw extra outer-eye strokes.

parameters.name: 小幅嘴形变化
parameters.notes: Default retains approved tiny angled stitch. No wide grin, lipstick or teeth.

parameters.name: 轻微惊讶开口（可选）
parameters.notes: Optional; no speech lip-sync in MVP.

parameters.name: 扶帽复合姿态
parameters.notes: Actual art deformation for an approved hand and hat. Must include hand-before-hat occlusion at the touch moment.

parameters.name: 被移动姿态
parameters.notes: Moves only pose inside renderer. Browser overlay owns screen position.

parameters.name: 放下缓冲
parameters.notes: No bouncy squashing or rubber texture.

parameters.name: 后发轻摆
parameters.notes: Physics output. Do not also key this in all idle motions.

parameters.name: 发辫轻摆
parameters.notes: Low amplitude; moderate damping.

parameters.name: 帽尖轻摆
parameters.notes: The brim mostly retains shape.

parameters.name: 铃铛摆动
parameters.notes: Slight pendulum movement; no automatic sound.

parameters.name: 围巾尾轻摆
parameters.notes: Short settling motion, no perpetual wind.

parameters.name: 裙摆轻摆
parameters.notes: Keep lace edge and folds coherent.

parameters.name: 工具袋轻摆
parameters.notes: Heavy pouch: smaller amplitude than scarf. Rigid scissors, no bending blades.

parameters.name: 腮红强弱（可选）
parameters.notes: Default must match source, not add vivid makeup.
